pinMethod: git ls-remote --symref URL HEAD before any clone; each pin is the advertised default-branch head and stays fixed even if the branch moves

priorUseCheck.scope: origin/main 866a7fd52: every tracked path (git grep -i -F OWNER/REPO), git log -i -F -G OWNER/REPO over benchmarks, docs, conformance, tools, .corvint and README.md, the primary checkout's .corvint ledgers, and the tracked dependency manifests (go.mod, go.sum, package-lock.json, requirements*.txt, pyproject.toml)
priorUseCheck.result: no match for any of the fifteen; none is in the development manifest, the blind-v2..v4 manifests, the untouched-repository-v1 packets (chi, cobra, urfave, viper, corvint) or the 25-repository ARB v2 corpus
priorUseCheck.replaced: tj/commander.js, python-attrs/attrs, fastapi/typer and Textualize/rich were drafted and dropped before pinning because tracked lock files install them (extensions/vscode, integrations/pi-protected, interop/spec-toolchains); encode/httpx was dropped because its name occurs in retained ARB result paths
priorUseCheck.limits: agent transcripts, unreachable Git objects and unrecorded private experiments were not searched; the Windows host ~/bench held no v0835 directory and no corvint on PATH

coin.value: the 40-hex lowercase commit id that `git ls-remote https://github.com/golang/go.git refs/tags/go1.27.4 'refs/tags/go1.27.4^{}'` reports for the peeled line when present, otherwise for the tag line
coin.noSubstitute: no other tag, date or source replaces this coin; until go1.27.4 is published the selection waits

selection.rankKey: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the ASCII bytes go1.27.4:COIN:ID (no newline)
selection.rule: rank all fifteen ids by rankKey ascending; take the lowest-ranked id of each group (go, python, javascript), then the two lowest-ranked ids not yet taken, regardless of group; the selected five are reported in rankKey order
selection.command: for id in $(jq -r '.pool[].id' benchmarks/blind-v7/pool.json); do printf '%s %s\n' "$(printf 'go1.27.4:%s:%s' "$COIN" "$id" | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-64)" "$id"; done | sort

authoring.host: Windows benchmark host, WSL2 Ubuntu, a new empty ~/bench/v0835/; the corvint binary is never installed or invoked there; only upstream source, git log and git grep
authoring.positiveCases: about 30 (six per selected repository); task text of at most 15 words taken from an issue or commit subject, never a symbol name; expected files and symbols with revision-pinned ground_truth; 1 to 3 must_exclude decoys each with a one-line reason of one kind: nearest-name same-file sibling, adjacent declaration, or same-named symbol elsewhere
authoring.outOfScopeProbes: 10 (two per selected repository), expected OUT_OF_SCOPE; each is a within-repository near miss naming a feature the repository lacks beside ones it has, with the nearby real declarations as must_exclude; never a misspelling of a real behaviour and never a cross-repository transplant
authoring.validation: before the preregistration digest, the frozen case files may be checked only for selector resolution and ground-truth lines (no evaluation, no retrieval output)

bars.mustExclude: aggregate.must_exclude_violations is 0, counted over every emitted result of every case
bars.abstentionPrecision: at least 0.8: cases answered OUT_OF_SCOPE with zero results that were expected OUT_OF_SCOPE, over all cases answered OUT_OF_SCOPE with zero results; no such answer scores 0
bars.abstentionRecall: at least 0.7: expected-OUT_OF_SCOPE cases answered OUT_OF_SCOPE with zero results, over all expected-OUT_OF_SCOPE cases
bars.latency: for every repository, corvint.metrics.latency_ms divided by corvint.metrics.cases is at most 5000
bars.verdict: PASS iff all five hold on the single run

run: exactly once, from a preregistration file (case digest, bars, pins, runner digest, one command) whose digest a decision records before the run; the report is committed unrepaired under benchmarks/results/ with partition heldout-v7
appeal: one route: a second person may void one decoy as mis-authored before seeing any other output, after which that case is development; available and unexercised unless a second person invokes it
